verdict.rationale: cubic ships a dedicated CLI that "reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them" (cubic-docs-7, cubic-probe-5), plus IDE/agent integration via cubic skills and an MCP server that lets coding agents read review findings and codebase context (cubic-docs-8, cubic-docs-35, cubic-probe-4), directly matching the story of catching issues pre-push in the editor. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the CLI's pre-push review quality and no community evidence specifically confirming the IDE experience (community citations discuss PR-level review, not the local CLI).
